judgment.notes: At S002, Z=Space, μ=dx, κ=ℝ, v=basis(j), f=V(·,t0)_k and g=Psp(j,·,t0)_k have exactly the types required by M003 and its displayed signature. D001/D014 and BG002 give finite dimensionality, the Borel structure and additive Haar measure; ℝ has the required normed real algebra structure. N001 and BG001 give both functions differentiable everywhere, hence on the opposite topological supports. N001 identifies Df(v)=W(j)_k and Dg(v)=Ssp(j)_k. Since t0>0 implies t0/2<t0<3t0/2, N002 supplies integrability separately for W(j)_k Psp(j)_k, V_k Ssp(j)_k and V_k Psp(j)_k. Thus all three integrability and both differentiability hypotheses hold. The resulting conclusion is precisely F002, with its stated sign. BG003 applies at S003 because every scalar summand is integrable. There are no E applications.
